name: Global-to-detailed parameter decomposition (inferred title)
purpose: Inferred from the data; not documented in any available ICD. Each record states that a 'detailed' monitoring parameter (column 2) is a bit field inside a 'global' monitoring parameter (column 1), starting column 3 bits after the start of the global parameter. Typical global parameters are whole words or octet strings that the spacecraft reports as one item (for example NAH0Z000 'APMHA_TM_1 [000]', an 8-bit unsigned integer with an on-board parameter ID); the detailed parameters are the flags and small enumerations inside them (NAHD0000 'APMHA_Mode', 3 bits at offset 0; NAHD0001, 1 bit at offset 3; and so on). The relation is consistent with the packet layouts: in all 215,859 cases (2025 release) where both parameters appear in the same packet, PLF bit position of the detailed parameter equals that of the global parameter plus column 3. SCOS-2000 extracts each parameter independently from PLF, so this table is probably used by mission tools, for example to generate PLF entries, to decode on-board parameter reports that carry only the global parameter, or to relate data-pool items to their fields. That use is an inference.

fields.name: COL1
fields.description: Inferred: name of the global (container) parameter. Always a pcf.PCF_NAME. 8,704 distinct globals in 2025; they are unsigned integers (3/4, 3/12, 3/13, 3/14) or fixed octet strings (PTC 7, up to 6,448 octets), and 14,016 rows refer to globals that have an on-board parameter ID (PCF_PID).

fields.name: COL2
fields.description: Inferred: name of the detailed parameter contained in the global one. Always a pcf.PCF_NAME and unique in the table (each detailed parameter belongs to exactly one global parameter). Mostly booleans, enumerations, unsigned integers and reals (e.g. 1/0, 2/n, 3/4, 3/12, 5/1).

fields.name: COL3
fields.description: Inferred: bit offset of the detailed parameter from the first (most significant) bit of the global parameter. Verified against PLF: detailed position = global position + offset in every co-located case (215,859 of 215,859 in 2025; 194,375 of 194,375 in 2020). No bit-field detail extends beyond the width of its integer or octet-string global.

relationships.note: All rows match; COL2 is unique (inferred).
Offset relation verified for every packet containing both parameters (inferred from data).

history: Not part of any ICD issue (5.1, 6.7 Draft A, 6.9, 7.0) nor of the pyscos2000 (7.2) schema. 52,417 rows in MIB__20200416M10720PFMS001_SOL, 56,631 rows in MIB__20250916M25925PFMS001_SOL, and 855 rows in the SWA instrument database. All 855 SWA rows also appear in the 2025 spacecraft table.
notes: All meanings inferred from the data. In the SWA instrument database no detailed parameter has a PLF entry (the global parameter is placed in plf in 841 of the 855 rows), while in the spacecraft MIB 841 of these 855 detailed parameters are placed in plf; this suggests that the spacecraft MIB generation expands global parameters into PLF entries for their details (inference). The name presumably abbreviates 'PCF global/detailed' (inference).
